messages:
tess: PTAL on https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4287 — addressed all comments, split flaky tests into a separate commit, and updated CHANGELOG. I also added a smoke script. CI is currently rerunning.

omar: thanks! quick q — did you re-run the latency microbench after the kv-cache change? small perf regression last time.

tess: yep, re-ran `scripts/run_latency.sh --samples 500` — median unchanged, p95 down 5ms. pasted output:
```
median: 22ms
p95: 38ms
```

leigh: looks good, one tiny nit: can we rename `smoke.sh` -> `smoke-api.sh` to be explicit? also add a short README line.

tess: done — renamed and added README blurb. also split test commit includes a comment explaining the flake reason. PTAL again.

merge-bot: CI passed on `main` (checks: unit, smoke, e2e). Auto-merge queued if approvals >=2.

omar: PTAL — looks good to me. approving now :white_check_mark: 

leigh: reviewed and approved. only concern is canary schedule — would like this to go during the 2pm slot today. @dave can you take the canary window?

dave: I can take 2pm slot. will monitor logs and tracer dashboards.

tess: great, thanks. if merge happens before 1:45 I'll hold the canary trigger until you're ready. tagging @release-coordinator for visibility.

release-coordinator: noted. canary scheduled at 14:00 UTC.

tess: awesome — thanks everyone :rocket:
